objectives.description: Build 14-case regression suite covering prefix/topic-only/task_type-only/both-declared/no-match/multiple-match/missing-script/non-executable/non-zero-rc/timeout/no-timeout-binary/failing-observer/malformed-declaration/dry-run; register in manifest.json

approaches_tried.approach: Initial fixture for case (l) wrote garbage into specs/state.json via the observer's own argument path and asserted byte-identity
approaches_tried.reason: The observer process is not sandboxed by run-task-observers.sh (out of scope for an advisory invoker); the write legitimately succeeded, so the fixture's premise was wrong. Redesigned to assert the SUT's OWN exit code and that it never touches state.json itself, with the observer only emitting garbage stdout/stderr.
